name: Citizenship by Investment (Cyprus Investment Programme) -- DISCONTINUED

requirements.blocker_text: The Cyprus Investment Programme, which formerly granted citizenship directly in exchange for a qualifying investment (commonly cited around EUR 2 million), was abolished by the Cypriot government effective 1 November 2020 following EU pressure and corruption/'golden passport' scandals; a final residual Cabinet-discretion loophole was reported closed as recently as December 2025. No investment-for-citizenship route currently exists.

sources.title: Al Jazeera -- Cyprus abolishes citizenship through investment programme (Oct 2020)
VisaHQ news -- Cyprus abolishes final loophole of 'golden passport' scheme, ending Cabinet discretion (Dec 2025)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Cyprus's initial build -- included DELIBERATELY, unlike a route that simply never existed, because this is a genuinely historically significant, real, and only recently (and repeatedly) closed-off pathway that anyone researching Cyprus immigration will encounter, and silently omitting it would be less honest than flagging it as closed. hard set to false since the entire point of this route is that no current qualifying path exists -- there is nothing to satisfy. closed_date set to the government's own effective abolition date (1 November 2020) per contemporaneous reporting; the Cabinet retained a narrow discretionary carve-out for some years afterward, which was itself reported closed in December 2025 -- both events are cited, since a reader could otherwise reasonably ask 'but wasn't there still a loophole?'. superseded_by is null: cy_permanent_residency_investment (Regulation 6(2)) is a real, active investment-migration route today, but it grants PERMANENT RESIDENCE, not citizenship directly, so it is not a true successor to this route's specific citizenship-by-investment mechanism -- an investor today must still go through ordinary naturalisation afterward. Around 222+ passports issued under the old scheme were reported revoked in subsequent investigations (per Investment Migration Council reporting), not modelled as a schema field but noted here for context.
